say:1:1341112001:1.text: Lorsan, Chippy's curious—what was it like being a snowman?
say:1:1341112001:1.source_cn: 洛桑，满满很好奇，你变成雪人的时候有什么感受？

say:2:1341112002:1.text: Hmm... I seemed to have some awareness, but I couldn't control my thoughts. My mind was flooded with all sorts of bizarre images.
say:2:1341112002:1.source_cn: 我想想……似乎有意识，可又无法控制自己的思维，脑子里飘...

say:3:1341112003:1.text: Oh, right! It was like having a very long dream!
say:3:1341112003:1.source_cn: 对了，像是在做一个很长很长的梦一样！

choice_prompt:4:1341112003.text: Oh, right! It was like having a very long dream!
choice_prompt:4:1341112003.source_cn: 对了，像是在做一个很长很长的梦一样！

say:5:1341112004:1.text: In the beginning, I was still conscious—I knew my name and could see and hear everything around me. I just couldn't move or speak a word.
say:5:1341112004:1.source_cn: 最开始的时候还有意识，知道自己的名字，也能听到周围的声...

say:6:1341112005:1.text: Then, my vision started to blur, like there was a thick layer of ice over my eyes. The sounds around me seemed distant.
say:6:1341112005:1.source_cn: 后来，一切开始逐渐变得模糊，就像是眼睛前面挡了一层厚厚...

say:7:1341112006:1.text: Did you feel cold? Were you hungry?
say:7:1341112006:1.source_cn: 那你会觉得冷吗？会觉得饿吗？

say:8:1341112007:1.text: Not at all, but it was a different story once I turned back—I felt so cold like my bones had turned into ice! I had to soak in the hot spring for a whole hour to feel better!
say:8:1341112007:1.source_cn: 完全不会，不冷也不饿，可一旦变回来就不同了，冷得好像骨...

say:9:1341112008:1.text: In the end, I seemed to have forgotten who I was, and I wasn't sure if I could still see and hear normally. My mind was simply filled with all kinds of strange scenes.
say:9:1341112008:1.source_cn: 到最后，我似乎已经不知道自己是谁了，也不知道自己到底能...

say:10:1341112009:1.text: I saw a distorted house, a massive blizzard, and a golden ray coming down from the sky. There was also gunfire, ice spikes, and the screams of many...
say:10:1341112009:1.source_cn: 有时候是万花筒一样扭曲变幻的屋子、巨大的暴风雪，有时候...

choice_prompt:11:1341112009.text: I saw a distorted house, a massive blizzard, and a golden ray coming down from the sky. There was also gunfire, ice spikes, and the screams of many...
choice_prompt:11:1341112009.source_cn: 有时候是万花筒一样扭曲变幻的屋子、巨大的暴风雪，有时候又是从天而降的金色光芒。哦对了，还有炮火、冰锥和很多人的嘶喊……

say:13:1341112010:1.text: Indeed... Magister, don't you think what Lorsan described sounds familiar?
say:13:1341112010:1.source_cn: 确实很疯狂……咦，梅林，你有没有觉得洛桑的描述很熟悉？
say:13:1341112010:1.male: Indeed... Magister, don't you think what Lorsan described sounds familiar?
say:13:1341112010:1.female: Indeed... Magister, don't you think what Lorsan described sounds familiar?

choice_prompt:14:1341112010.text: Indeed... Magister, don't you think what Lorsan described sounds familiar?
choice_prompt:14:1341112010.source_cn: 确实很疯狂……咦，梅林，你有没有觉得洛桑的描述很熟悉？
choice_prompt:14:1341112010.male: Indeed... Magister, don't you think what Lorsan described sounds familiar?
choice_prompt:14:1341112010.female: Indeed... Magister, don't you think what Lorsan described sounds familiar?

say:15:1341112011:1.text: Do you mean your battle with Frost Furie in the castle?
say:15:1341112011:1.source_cn: 你们的经历？你是说你们在城堡里和冰之恶魔战斗时候发生的事情？

say:17:1341112012:1.text: Right! The castle was horribly distorted by Frost Furie's magic, and there were illusions everywhere. She used the blizzard to knock us into an abyss...
say:17:1341112012:1.source_cn: 对呀！城堡里被冰之恶魔的魔法扭曲得乱七八糟的，还出现了...

say:18:1341112013:1.text: Golden beam... That sounds like Dura's seal to me! The gunfire, ice spikes, and screams must be from the ancient battlefield!
say:18:1341112013:1.source_cn: 金色的光芒……唔，很像是艾雅的封印！炮火、冰锥和嘶喊声...

say:19:1341112014:1.text: What an epic adventure! Traveling back in time, navigating through illusions and a twisted castle... Misarte above, I wish I could have been there with you!
say:19:1341112014:1.source_cn: 看来你们这次的经历很有趣！回到过去，幻境，扭曲的城堡…...

choice:14:0:1.text: It's similar to what we experienced in the castle.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 有点像我们在城堡里经历的事情
choice:14:0:1.male: It's similar to what we experienced in the castle.
choice:14:0:1.female: It's similar to what we experienced in the castle.

choice:11:1:2.text: Sounds similar to what we went through.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 似乎和我们的经历有点相似
choice:11:1:2.male: Sounds similar to what we went through.
choice:11:1:2.female: Sounds similar to what we went through.

choice:4:0:1.text: Most likely, it was a nightmare.
choice:4:0:1.male: Most likely, it was a nightmare.
choice:4:0:1.female: Most likely, it was a nightmare.
